title: G8 PORT — master state schema (one JSON per question / per ported Pine script)
description: Every generator writes exactly one file matching this schema to data/state/<script>.json. Gate M and journal columns are mandatory from day one (D8). Missing data is never null/zero: last-good value + quality=STALE + age_bd (principle 2).

question.description: The ONE question this script answers (doctrine: one script = one question = one place).

pine_version.description: Version of the Pine script being ported, e.g. v1_1_3_EN. Frozen thresholds come from here.

commit.description: Commit of the repo state that produced this file.

twin_test.description: D9: nothing enters the funnel without a closed twin-test.

state_discrepancy_pct.description: % of bars where Pine state != Python state. >10 → FAILED + acta.

acta.description: Path to gates/actas/*.md if a recalibration acta exists.

funnel_eligible.description: Derived: twin_test.status == PASSED. funnel.py refuses anything else.

inputs.description: Every input series actually consumed in this run, with provenance (principle 3).

data_date.description: Date OF the observation, not of the download.

age_bd.description: Business days old by the feed's own country calendar (principle 4).

calendar.description: Business-day calendar used: US, EU, GB, JP, AU, CA, NZ, CH, CME.

plausibility.description: Principle 5. REJECTED → value shown is last good, quality=STALE, alert raised.

outputs.description: Script-specific results. Keys are the Pine plot/table names, untranslated. Two mandatory sub-objects: per_ccy and pairs (pairs may be empty for non-pair scripts).

label.description: Global regime label of the script (e.g. RISK-ON / STRESS / NEUTRAL). Drives Telegram diff (D6).

state.description: Discrete state as in Pine (this is what the twin-test compares).

percentile.description: MEASURED percentile over window_bars — never assumed.

thresholds_frozen.description: The exact frozen thresholds applied (Rule 32). Copied verbatim from the Pine inputs.

na_reason.description: If state is NA: which input caused the pause (NA = pause, not reset).

pairs.description: Only for scripts that emit pair-level output (IYDT/PairDIV). Keys like EURUSD.

dqm.description: Health of THIS script's inputs (the global DQM lives in dqm.json).

alerts.description: Human-readable, one per problem. Non-empty → Telegram (principle 9).

gate_m.description: Gate M (pre-registered exam of the macro layer). Filled EVERY run so the exam can be reconstructed from history. See gates/GATE_M_prereg_v0.1.md.

is_oos.description: true if generated_at > cutoff_date (out-of-sample for this script).

cutoff_date.description: Per-script calibration cut-off. Resolves audit finding (a).

signal_snapshot.description: Minimal frozen copy of what Gate M evaluates: per ccy/pair → state + direction + score at this timestamp.

forward_windows_bd.description: Horizons over which realised outcomes will be measured (e.g. [5,10,20]).

realised.description: Filled by the Gate M runner post-hoc, never by the generator.

journal_link.description: Lets a journal row point back to the exact state that justified it.

state_hash.description: sha256 of outputs (canonical JSON). Journal rows reference this.

diff_vs_prev.description: Keys whose state changed since previous run. Empty → no Telegram (D6).
